title: Input

max_seq.title: Max Seq
max_seq.description: Maximum number of hits to return. Higher values capture more distant homologs but increase search time.

chain_id.title: Chain Id
chain_id.description: Chain ID to extract from pdb_path. Required when pdb_path is provided.

pdb_path.title: Pdb Path
pdb_path.description: PDB or mmCIF structure file. The sequence of chain_id will be extracted and used as query. Must be provided with chain_id.

sequence.title: Sequence
sequence.description: Input sequence. Provide either this OR pdb_path+chain_id, not both. Prioritize the sequence over pdb_path+chain_id.

custom_output_path.title: Custom Output Path
custom_output_path.description: Resolved output destination. Set by framework — see gateway.source.ApiSource.resolve_output_dest().
